meta.title: Graphic Design Studio
meta.description: One sentence in, an editable design out. The user is the only authority: every explicit requirement is copied verbatim into brief-lock.md and proved at delivery, never ignored, softened or replaced. Style is never picked from a built-in catalogue - it is researched on the spot by searching the whole open web (any real design counts, and references need no licence because they never enter the artwork) with search phrases built from the words the user actually used, read image by image, and compressed into a traceable, executable style DNA that you approve in refs-approved.md before any canvas opens. It does not act as a style judge: no palette caps, whitespace quotas, slop checklists or aesthetic scores. Picture sources follow your instructions (photographs, no photographs, type only, pure vector are all honoured), assets are licensed and credited automatically (CC0/CC BY, AI generation, OFL fonts), and a silence clock keeps approvals from deadlocking. Final files ship from VectorCraft/DesignCraft/PhotoCraft/HTML canvas as editable sources plus PNG/PDF.
